about.heading: About Sarvesh Chavan
about.lead: I am Sarvesh Chavan, a 1st-year B.Tech CSE (AI/ML) student with a strong focus on front-end development.
about.body: I enjoy crafting clean, responsive, and accessible web interfaces from first principles. I focus on semantic HTML, modern CSS, and vanilla JavaScript without unnecessary complexity. Outside of coding, I enjoy playing ground sports, building in Minecraft, and watching anime.

principles.title: 1. Structure & Accessibility First
principles.description: Prioritize semantic HTML landmarks, clear readable typography, and complete keyboard navigability.

principles.title: 2. Build Small & Test Often
principles.description: Construct modular, tested components and responsive layouts that adapt smoothly across all screen sizes.

principles.title: 3. Keep It Honest
principles.description: Show ground-truth code and real implementations rather than superficial percentage bars or inflated claims.

projects.title: AMENDMENT
projects.summary: An interactive board game interface where players propose and vote on dynamic rule changes mid-match.
projects.problem: Displaying constantly evolving game rules and active match states clearly to players without confusing layout shifts or visual clutter.
projects.whatIDid: Designed and implemented the complete front-end user interface, responsive component layouts, and typography. Won the Hacktoberfest event organized at NST.
